## Observation datasets

### titanium\_omega\_dewaele\_2015\_table4\_compression

- **Description:** All 41 omega-Ti lattice-parameter observations printed in Table IV across runs 1-3, including decompression points.
- **Kind:** pressure\_lattice\_parameters
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Dewaele; Stutzmann; Bouchet; Bottin; Occelli; Mezouar
    - **Year:** 2015
    - **Source:** Phys. Rev. B
    - **Volume:** 91
    - **Locator:** 134108
    - **DOI:** 10.1103/PhysRevB.91.134108
- **Source location:** Table IV, omega-Ti columns
- **Associated EOS records:** titanium\_omega\_dewaele\_2015\_vinet\_1
- **Notes:** Runs 1-2 used ruby and run 3 used tungsten as pressure markers. Formula-unit volume is a^2\*c/(2\*sqrt(3)). The visually verified printed value a=4.010 angstrom at 66.3 GPa is retained verbatim despite being nonmonotonic with adjacent rows; pointwise uncertainties are not tabulated.
